description: Session file text accepted or rejected by the strict session decoder (game-rules.md section 4), shared by Apple and web. A case carries `session` (a JSON value), `json` (exact file text) or `base64` (exact file bytes). When `padToBytes` is present, the runner appends ASCII spaces to `json` until its UTF-8 encoding is exactly that many bytes, so the 2 MiB limit is tested without storing 2 MiB here. A session is valid only when it matches session-v1.schema.json (sessionVersion 1) or session-v2.schema.json (sessionVersion 2) and replays without error.
